content_sections.heading: NHM Goa Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: NHM Goa has advertised 125 vacancies across 28 designations under various National Health Mission programmes (NPCDCS, NTEP, NUHM, DEIC, NPPCD, HR Flexipool, IEC, RMNCHAN, and others). The category-wise breakup for each post, where specified, is given in parentheses. The total of 125 vacancies is computed from the individual post-wise figures given in the notification. NHM Goa reserves the right to modify or amend the number of vacancies, terms, or place of posting at any stage without prior notice.

content_sections.heading: NHM Goa Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements differ for each of the 28 posts. A summary of the essential qualification for each post is given below; candidates should refer to the official notification for the complete essential and desirable qualification details, including posting-specific requirements. Knowledge of Konkani is essential for all posts, and knowledge of Marathi is desirable, as per the notification. Applications without valid council registration (wherever applicable) will not be entertained.

rows.essential_qualification_summary: M.D. in Medicine or equivalent (MCI recognised) + specialist training in Endocrinology or Cardiology
MBBS with valid Goa Medical Council Registration + completed compulsory rotatory internship
M.Sc. (Zoology) with entomology as one subject + computer knowledge of MS Office
MPhil/Masters in Clinical/Child Psychology or Rehabilitation Psychology + minimum 1 year experience with children with special needs
Graduate in Audiology & Speech Language Pathology/BASLP from an RCI-recognised institute with valid RCI registration
BAMS/BHMS + Master in Hospital Management/Health Management/Public Health Management (2-year full-time programme)
Graduate in Business Administration/Public Health, or Diploma in Hospital/Material/Supply Chain Management, or Degree/Diploma in Medical Electronic Engineering
B.Sc. (Nursing) with MLHP course integrated; passed from batch 2019-20 onward; enrolled with Goa Nursing Council; competent in MS Office and Internet
B.Sc./Diploma in Nursing (Nursing Council of India) + registration as staff nurse/midwife with Goa Nursing Council + 2 years hospital experience
B.Sc. Nursing/Diploma in Basic Nursing + registration as staff nurse/midwife with Goa Nursing Council
B.Sc. Nursing/Diploma in Basic Nursing (GNM)
PG in Computer Science (M.Sc./MCA) or BE in IT/Electronics/Computer Science
Minimum SSC/HSC + Indian Sign Language (ISL) C Certificate or DISLIC
HSSC + one-year diploma in Audiology
Post Graduate + 1 year experience in communication/ACSM/PPP/Health Projects + permanent two-wheeler driving licence
B.Com with Statistics as one subject + Diploma in Computer Application or 6-month certificate course in Computers
Graduate in Computer Application with MS Office + 1 year MIS/File Management experience + knowledge of Konkani
Graduate with Diploma/Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology + 2 years experience in a Govt.-recognised medical laboratory
Bachelor's Degree or recognised sanitary inspector's course + certificate course in computer operation + permanent two-wheeler driving licence
B.Pharm/D.Pharm registered with Goa State Pharmacy Council
XII Pass + successful completion of Dental Technician Course
Graduate in Science + Diploma in Computer Application or 5-month certificate course in Computer Application
Bachelor's Degree in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology + computer knowledge of MS Office
SSCE with 1.5-year Multipurpose Health Worker training or completion of 2-year Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) training
Graduate in Science, or Intermediate in Science with MPW/LHV/ANM/health worker experience, or recognised TB Health Visitor's course + computer certificate course
Served as an ANM with 5 years of experience
B.Ed./D.Ed in Special Education (Mental Retardation/Locomotor and Neurological Disorder) or PG Diploma in Special Education recognised by RCI
Middle pass or VIII class pass + knowledge of Konkani

faq.question: Q1. What is NHM Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NHM Goa Recruitment 2026 is a contractual recruitment drive by the National Health Mission, Directorate of Health Services, Goa, to fill 125 posts across 28 designations for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NHM Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 125 vacancies are available across 28 posts, ranging from Specialist Cardiologist and Medical Officer to Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, Counsellor, and Support Staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NHM Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from Middle/VIII class pass for Support Staff to postgraduate medical degrees for Specialist Cardiologist. Full post-wise qualification is listed in the Eligibility Criteria section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NHM Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably not less than 18 years and not exceeding 40 years, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PH candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for NHM Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Google Form link https://forms.gle/F5rw7ULinXEjSUJZ9 by filling in their personal, educational, and category details before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NHM Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification indicates selection involves an interview, at which hard copies of the application and documents must be produced. The detailed selection process is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for NHM Goa Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Monthly consolidated remuneration ranges from ₹8,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- depending on the post, as detailed in the Salary section above.
